lines.en: label halloweenfour4:
scene hallomakomiku1
song change.
lines.zh: 换歌。

lines.en: : Hello, Makoto and Miku. The time has come for me to ignore everyone else and talk to you for several minutes before ultimately leaving in order to even out all of the characters’ screen time.
lines.zh: : 你们好，Makoto 和 Miku。是时候让我无视其他所有人，跟你们聊上几分钟，然后最终走人，好把所有角色的出场时间拉平了。

lines.en: : You in some kinda game or somethin’ now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是活在什么游戏里还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Sometimes, it feels that way. That explanation of things is getting canned and tiresome though and it’s about time I start growing up and looking at the world as a world. Am I right?
lines.zh: : 有时候确实有这种感觉。不过这种解释已经变得老套又乏味，我也该成熟一点，把世界当成世界来看。我说得对吧？

lines.en: : I ain’t got any clue what you’re talkin’ about, but probably. I like leavin’ all the difficult decisions and stuff to adults.
lines.zh: : 我完全听不懂你在说啥，不过大概对吧。我就喜欢把麻烦的决定什么的都丢给大人。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I’d even count Sensei as an adult at this point in time.
lines.zh: : 我不确定到了现在这个地步，还能不能把 Sensei 算作一个成年人。

lines.en: : I would. Otherwise, you probably wouldn’t want to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 我会。不然你大概也不会想跟我上床了。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku2
laughtrack.
lines.zh: 罐头笑声。

lines.en: : Was that really necessary?
lines.zh: : 有这个必要吗？

lines.en: : He ain’t wrong. If ya ask me, a lotta Sensei’s charm is the fact that he can get us into R-rated movies and teach us how to do our taxes and stuff.
lines.zh: : 他又没说错。要我说，Sensei 的魅力很大一部分就在于他能带我们进限制级电影，还教我们怎么报税什么的。

lines.en: : Ami would probably be better off at that last part than me, but I feel as if I’m only saying that because memories from an alternate universe are subtly popping into my head right now.
lines.zh: : 最后那件事 Ami 大概比我在行，不过我总觉得我之所以会这么说，是因为某个平行宇宙的记忆正悄悄往我脑子里冒。

lines.en: : Well, try to keep yourself grounded for a moment longer as I have an important matter that needs to be discussed right now.
lines.zh: : 那就请你再脚踏实地一会儿，因为我现在有件重要的事要谈。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku3
: Oh, come on! Can’t ya hold off until the party’s over at least? There ain’t no need to get all depressing right now when the night’s only just begun!
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托！你至少不能等到派对结束再说吗？夜晚才刚开始，没必要现在就搞得这么压抑！

lines.en: : I agree with Miku. I’ve got enough going on internally right now to last the rest of the year. Or whatever’s left of it, at least. Which could be anywhere from thirty seconds to a million years.
lines.zh: : 我同意 Miku。我心里现在攒的事，够我撑到今年年底了。或者说，够撑到今年剩下的那点时间——大概从三十秒到一百万年不等。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku4
: Now, I ain’t no math whiz, but I’m pretty sure you’re wrong about that one, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我数学虽然不好，但我敢肯定这句你说错了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I suppose considering that {i}both{/i} of you are going to be dodgy and reluctant to engage on this matter, I’ll keep what I have to say short and sweet.
lines.zh: : 既然你们{i}两个{/i}都要在这件事上躲躲闪闪、不肯正面回应，那我就长话短说吧。

lines.en: : I do not know what you did, or what you {i}thought{/i} you were doing, but there are some things that I will not allow to slip by me even {i}in{/i} a never-ending school year.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你做了什么，也不知道你{i}以为{/i}自己在做什么，但有些事即便{i}在{/i}这永无止境的学年里，我也绝不会让它从我眼皮底下溜过去。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku5
: A never-ending what now? The heck is going on with both of you?
lines.zh: : 永无止境的什么？你们俩到底在搞什么鬼？

lines.en: : I’m disappointed in you, Sensei. I’m sure I don’t have to tell you why.
lines.zh: : 我对你很失望，Sensei。我想我不必说为什么。

lines.en: : Do you have anything to say for yourself?
lines.zh: : 你没有什么要为自己辩解的吗？

lines.en: : Only that I knew this was coming and it doesn’t make it any less demoralizing to hear you say that.
lines.zh: : 只有一点：我早就知道会有这一天，但听你亲口说出来，依然一样让人泄气。

lines.en: : Good. You {i}should{/i} be demoralized. In fact, you should be much {i}more{/i} than that. Because if it weren’t for my mother and me, Miku would likely be foaming from the mouth in her bed right now.
lines.zh: : 很好。你{i}就该{/i}泄气。事实上，你应该比这更泄气才对。因为要不是我和我妈，Miku 现在大概正躺在床上口吐白沫。

lines.en: : The heck is gonna happen to my mouth?
lines.zh: : 我的嘴会怎么着？

lines.en: : Be quiet, Miku. I’ve already scolded {i}you.{/i} It’s Sensei’s turn now.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Miku。{i}你{/i}我已经骂过了。现在轮到 Sensei。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku6
: I already told ya, Makoto. Sensei didn’t have anythin’ to do with what happened. That whole thing was on me and nobody else.
lines.zh: : 我都跟你说过了，Makoto。那件事跟 Sensei 一点关系都没有。全都是我自己的问题，跟别人无关。

lines.en: : Is that true, Sensei? Did you really have {i}absolutely no{/i} knowledge of this whatsoever? Or would you like to use this opportunity to try honesty for the first-
lines.zh: : 是真的吗，Sensei？你真的{i}完全{/i}不知情吗？还是你想借这个机会，有生以来第一次试试诚实-

lines.en: : I knew.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : I knew and I didn’t do anything about it because I was scared.
lines.zh: : 我知道，但我什么都没做，因为我害怕。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 还有，对不起。

lines.en: : It won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 不会再有下次了。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku7

: Forgive what I can only imagine will be a rather offensive question, but...are you abusing drugs as well? Because there is no circumstance in which I can imagine you {i}genuinely{/i} saying what you just said.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我这个我想会很冒犯的问题，不过……你是不是也在嗑药？因为在任何情况下，我都无法想象你会{i}真心{/i}说出刚才那些话。

lines.en: : I’m not. You’ve saved my ass eight million times and you’re still courteous enough to give me the benefit of the doubt when I haven’t deserved it even once.
lines.zh: : 没有。你救了我八百万次，而我一次都不配，你却依然愿意姑且相信我。

lines.en: : It’s no wonder I love you.
lines.zh: : 难怪我会爱你。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku8
: Jeez! Get a friggin’ room if yer gonna be sayin’ stuff like that!
lines.zh: : 天哪！要说这种话就去开个房啊！

lines.en: : That...you...why...
lines.zh: : 那……你……为什么……

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku9
: Stop it! You’re not supposed to say things like that in public! Let alone while I’m mad at you!
lines.zh: : 别说了！这种话不该在公共场合说！更别说还是在我生你气的时候！

lines.en: : You ain’t ever told me you love {i}me.{/i} What’s the deal with that?
lines.zh: : 你从来没跟{i}我{/i}说过你爱我。这算怎么回事？

lines.en: : That’s easy. I don’t love you.
lines.zh: : 这简单。我不爱你。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku10
: What the heck?! At least fake it, ya jerk!
lines.zh: : 搞什么鬼？！至少装装样子啊，混蛋！

lines.en: : R...Regardless of how you feel about me...don’t...don’t let me down like that again. Okay?
lines.zh: : 不……不管你对我是什么感情……别……别再那样让我失望了。好吗？

lines.en: : Miku’s not only my friend, she’s family. And if anything ever happened to her, I...have no idea what I’d do.
lines.zh: : Miku 不只是我的朋友，她是我的家人。要是她出了什么事，我……不知道自己会做出什么。

lines.en: : I know. I’ve known that from the start and I’m sorry you have to always put up with a sack of shit like me.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我从一开始就知道，也很抱歉你总得忍受我这么一坨屎。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku11
: Well, now you’re just startin’ to sound like Io.
lines.zh: : 得，你现在说话越来越像 Io 了。

lines.en: : Miku’s right. You sound rather self-deprecating and miserable by even {i}your{/i} standards, Sensei. Has this really gotten to you this badly?
lines.zh: : Miku 说得对。就算按{i}你{/i}的标准，你听起来也相当自贬、相当凄惨，Sensei。这事真的把你打击到这种程度了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s what’s going on. Like, sure, it probably doesn’t {i}help.{/i} But ever since I woke up, I’ve felt like there are strings attached to my shoulders and waist that are just dragging me around.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是那么回事。当然，这大概也{i}没什么帮助{/i}。但自从我醒来，我就觉得肩膀和腰上系着线，就这么被拖着到处走。

lines.en: : My mouth is dry. My head hurts. Everything seems foggy. And scenes keep cutting out in the middle of-
lines.zh: : 我口干舌燥。头也疼。一切都雾蒙蒙的。而且场景总是在中途突然断掉-

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku12
: ...the revolution!
: The what now?
lines.zh: : 什么玩意儿？

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku13
: The revolution, damn it! Us girls have been oppressed for far too long and the time has come for us to rise up and say to the fashion industry, “We deserve pockets too!”
lines.zh: : 革命，该死的！我们女生被压迫太久了，是时候站起来对时尚产业说：「我们也配拥有口袋！」

lines.en: : Real pockets! Ones we can fit a full phone in instead of just 33%% of one!
lines.zh: : 真正的口袋！能装下一整部手机的那种，而不是只能塞进 33%！

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re advocating for this at all when you’ve already found a way to defy the laws of fashion by storing an entire room’s worth of stuff in that band you keep wrapped around your thigh.
lines.zh: : 我还挺意外你会提倡这个，毕竟你已经靠那条绑在大腿上的带子装下了整整一个房间的东西，早就公然违反了时尚法则。

lines.en: : My ingenuity means nothing in the face of a much greater evil! Tell ‘em, Kirin!
lines.zh: : 在更大的邪恶面前，我这点小巧思一文不值！告诉她们，Kirin！

lines.en: : It’s all a conspiracy. All of the major brands are in the pockets of handbag companies and adding full-sized pockets to their pants would cause a rift in the market that could crash the economy.
lines.zh: : 这全是一场阴谋。所有大牌都被手袋公司收买了，要是给裤子加上全尺寸口袋，就会在市场上撕出一道裂缝，足以让经济崩盘。

lines.en: : And it is {i}we{/i} who have to suffer because of this corporate greed! It is {i}we{/i} who must always lose our phones or tie things around our legs so the rich can get richer!
lines.zh: : 而因为这种企业贪婪，受苦的是{i}我们{/i}！是{i}我们{/i}总是弄丢手机、或者把东西绑在腿上，好让富人越来越富！

lines.en: : But I like handbags. A lot of them are really cute. I don’t think having pockets is enough to make me, like...not want to buy one.
lines.zh: : 可我喜欢手袋啊。很多手袋真的很可爱。我觉得光有口袋还不足以让我，那个……不想买手袋。

lines.en: : You guys talk about some real boring shit, you know.
lines.zh: : 你们聊的东西真他妈无聊，你知道吗。

lines.en: : But yeah, I’m down for some deeper pockets. The ones on these shorts are so tight I’m surprised they didn’t come with our teacher’s fingers stuffed inside ‘em.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，想要更深的口袋我赞成。这条短裤的口袋紧得要命，我都很惊讶它没把我们老师的手指一起塞在里面。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku14
: Hot.
lines.zh: : 好辣。

lines.en: : Super hot.
lines.zh: : 超级辣。

lines.en: : Yumi, come on.
lines.zh: : Yumi，别闹了。

lines.en: : What? I’m just sayin’ I support whatever the fuck’s bein’ sold to me right now. And as the only person here with an entrepreneurial record, I’m pretty sure that’s a fair thing for me to do.
lines.zh: : 怎么？我只是说，现在他们卖什么我都支持。再说了，作为在场唯一有创业履历的人，我觉得我这么做相当合理。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’re {i}not{/i} the only person here with an “entrepreneurial record” since Kirin’s been selling her nudes online since the third grade.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你{i}不是{/i}这里唯一有「创业履历」的人，Kirin 从三年级就开始在网上卖自己的裸照了。

lines.en: : Hey, good one.
lines.zh: : 嘿，说得好。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku15
: What do you mean, “good one?” That’s the part where you’re supposed to say something mean about me. Then we go back and forth throwing shade at each other until one of us walks away.
lines.zh: : 什么叫「说得好」？这时候你应该说点难听的回敬我才对。然后我们你来我往地互相嘲讽，直到其中一个人走开。

lines.en: : Meh. I don’t feel like it tonight.
lines.zh: : 算了。我今晚没那个心情。

lines.en: : That was funny and I’m not about to start shit with you just because you made some joke about me being a slut while my underwear’s pulled up higher than my shorts.
lines.zh: : 那句挺好笑的，我也不会因为你说我是荡妇——而且我的内裤比短裤还提得高——就要跟你闹起来。

lines.en: : So yeah! Good one. And also, you look really hot in that pirate costume. Did you make it yourself?
lines.zh: : 所以啊！说得好。还有，你穿那身海盗装真的很辣。你自己做的吗？

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku16
: Uh...th...thank you? And...Uta and I made them together.
lines.zh: : 呃……谢……谢谢？还有……是我和 Uta 一起做的。

lines.en: : Cool. Invite me next time.
lines.zh: : 酷。下次叫上我。

lines.en: : Sorry, are we friends now? How did that happen?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我们现在是朋友了？这是怎么发生的？

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku17
: I don’t know if we’re {i}friends.{/i} I just don’t really hate you or anything. I totally get it if you hate me, though. I can be a real bitch sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我们算不算{i}朋友{/i}。我只是没那么讨厌你什么的。不过你要是讨厌我，我完全理解。我有时候确实挺婊的。

lines.en: : What on earth is happening right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底在发生什么？

lines.en: : Kirin’s reached her “good girl” arc and we’re all supposed to encourage her so that, one day, she’ll wear costumes with the underwear pulled a little bit lower.
lines.zh: : Kirin 进入了她的「好女孩」篇章，我们都应该鼓励她，这样有朝一日她穿的衣服内裤就能往下拽一点了。

lines.en: : Noriko’s right. The time has finally come for me to start growing up.
lines.zh: : Noriko 说得对。我终于也该开始长大了。

lines.en: : Well...congrats and all, but exactly how many dudes did you have to fuck before you got to that point?
lines.zh: : 嗯……恭喜什么的，不过你到底得跟多少个男的上床才能到那一步？

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku18
: Just one. But he fucks me so good it makes me want to {i}change my ways.{/i}
lines.zh: : 只有一个。但他干得我太爽了，让我想{i}改过自新{/i}。

lines.en: : Have you, like...actually done it? Because I can’t tell if you’re just screwing with me right now.
lines.zh: : 你，那个……真的做过？因为我分不清你是不是在耍我。

lines.en: : Oh yeah. Tons of times. Have you?
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。做过好多次了。你呢？

lines.en: : Well...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Jesus fucking Christ, do the three of you have any interest in literally {i}anything{/i} that doesn’t involve a dick?
lines.zh: : 我操你妈的耶稣啊，你们三个对{i}任何{/i}不带鸡巴的东西就没一点兴趣吗？

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku19
: Hey! I’ve been good tonight! I just wanted to talk about pants and female oppression!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我今晚一直很乖！我只是想聊聊裤子和女性压迫！

lines.en: : Then put a leash on fucking Annie Chokely here and get her to talk about something else! This kinda shit makes some people uncomfortable, you know.
lines.zh: : 那就给这个该死的 Annie Chokely 套上狗绳，让她聊点别的！这种东西有些人听着会不舒服，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Fine, fine. Let’s all do what the birthday girl wants and talk about her special day instead. Ooh! We can even sing her a song and get her a cake.
lines.zh: : 好好好。那就按寿星的意思来，聊聊她的特别日子吧。哦！我们甚至可以给她唱首歌、买个蛋糕。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku20
: Aight, never mind. Go back to talkin’ about gettin’ raw dogged or whatever. Ain’t nobody singin’ to me.
lines.zh: : 行吧，算了。还是回去聊被无套干什么的吧。谁也别给我唱歌。

lines.en: : Oh, right. It {i}is{/i} your birthday, isn’t it? How did I forget?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。今天{i}确实{/i}是你生日，对吧？我怎么会忘了？

lines.en: : How’d you even {i}know?{/i} Don’t remember ever tellin’ you. Or anybody for that matter.
lines.zh: : 你{i}怎么{/i}知道的？我不记得跟你说过。跟谁都没说过。

lines.en: : We keep an extensive profile of everyone in the class so we can be fully prepared for our end-of-the-year orgy party.
lines.zh: : 我们给班上每个人都建了详尽的档案，好为年终群交派对做好充分准备。

lines.en: : That is not why we keep extensive profiles on everyone. But I will admit that I can see it helping with such a thing should my self-esteem ever be reduced to the point in which I would do that.
lines.zh: : 我们建详尽档案可不是为了这个。不过我承认，要是我的自尊心有一天跌到那个地步，这确实能帮上忙。

lines.en: : I think I’ll speak on Yumi’s behalf right now and say thanks for the offer to sing, but...that’s not really her thing.
lines.zh: : 我想我替 Yumi 说一句：谢谢你们要唱歌的好意，不过……那真不是她的风格。

lines.en: : Is {i}anything{/i} her thing? Because it seems like Halloween isn’t either if she’s never even going to dress up for it.
lines.zh: : 她有{i}什么{/i}风格吗？看样子万圣节也不是，毕竟她连装扮都懒得弄。

lines.en: : So what? Noriko’s not dressed up either.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？Noriko 也没打扮啊。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku21
: Don’t worry, Noriko. I’m sure {i}somebody{/i} is bound to recognize your costume tonight.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Noriko。我相信今晚{i}总有人{/i}会认出你的装扮。

lines.en: : Oh, shit. Are you actually dressed up as someone? It just looked like a normal uniform to me.
lines.zh: : 哦，靠。你真的扮了某个人？我还以为那就是普通制服。

lines.en: : She’s that chick from Your Name, ain’t she? Mitsuha or whatever. You can tell from the ribbon.
lines.zh: : 她是《你的名字。》里那个女的吧？三叶还是什么的。看那条发带就知道了。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku22
: Yes! That’s exactly it! Thank God that {i}someone{/i} finally noticed! I was about to disown all of you!
lines.zh: : 对！就是这个！谢天谢地{i}终于有人{/i}看出来了！我差点就要跟你们所有人断绝关系！

lines.en: : Well, that was the last person I would have guessed to pick up on it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我最想不到会认出来的就是她。

lines.en: : Yeah, how the hell did {i}you{/i} know that? That’s a romance movie, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 对啊，{i}你{/i}怎么会知道？那不是爱情片吗？

lines.en: : I watched it with Chinami while you were at work a while back. It was actually pretty good.
lines.zh: : 之前你去上班的时候，我和 Chinami 一起看的。其实还挺好看的。

lines.en: : Plus, it ain’t like I’m {i}against{/i} that kind of shit. You know I read manga.
lines.zh: : 再说，我又不是{i}排斥{/i}那种东西。你知道我看漫画的。

lines.en: scene hallomakomiku23
: Yeah, but you read all of that action and sports stuff they aim at little boys.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你看的都是那种瞄准小男孩的动作和运动漫画。

lines.en: : Doesn’t mean I don’t, like...what’s the phrase again?...Oh, yeah. Doesn’t mean I don’t {i}broaden my horizons{/i} every once in a while, though.
lines.zh: : 那也不代表我不，那个……那句话怎么说来着？……哦，对。那也不代表我不会偶尔{i}拓宽一下视野{/i}。

lines.en: : Do you want to watch it together sometime? I love that movie. In fact, I love pretty much {i}everything{/i} Shinkai has-
